quote: Now, 60 years after it was posed, this problem has finally been solved in the positive
note: Olly Britton's blog states the problem was posed 60 years before its solution in March 2024, placing the origin at 1964. The Wikipedia article notes it was one of Conway's 'anti-Hilbert problems' from about 40 years before 2002 (~1962), consistent with this date. No primary source with an exact year has been located; 1964 is derived from the '60 years' statement.
